💿CI/CD(benchmark): route SDK main events to central runs (#1)

SDK main changes need a central benchmark run with a fixed Rust/Go
source pair and durable request history. This PR adds the central
receiver, request ledger, and result publication path so SDK callers can
dispatch an exact main-push SHA without owning the measurement workflow.

- Resolve and validate SDK main-push origins, pin the selected source
pair once, and preserve it across duplicate deliveries and retries.
- Run compatibility checks and both SDK suites in a read-only
measurement job; record effective dependency locks with the raw samples
and export provenance.
- Publish successful results and request status atomically to
`bench-data`; retain failed or incompatible attempts without advancing
the latest successful result.
- Document dispatch, recovery, and result publication behavior. The SDK
caller PRs should be merged only after this receiver is on `main` and
the dispatch credential is available.

Validation: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` (43 passed);
`python3 -m compileall -q scripts tests`; `actionlint
.github/workflows/benchmark.yml`; `git diff --check`. Prior isolated
local validation also completed smoke (34 samples), full measurement
(340 measured plus 34 warmup), exploratory export, and an incompatible
SDK pairing. Real SDK main-push dispatch and official publication remain
to be verified after rollout.

commit.message:
📜docs(workflow): align dispatch credential with SDK callers (#2)

The central workflow guide names a different dispatch secret from the
SDK callers. Update the credential setup to use `WORKFLOW_PAT` and
explain that its permissions must include Actions write on
`qortoo/qortoo-bench` alongside its other destinations.

Validation: compared the guide with both SDK caller workflows and ran
`git diff --check`. Documentation only; no workflow or secret settings
change.
